Objectives: Provision test environments (web, worker, storage) | Verify basic end-to-end pipeline: submit job -> worker processes -> store results | Sanity checks for authentication and API connectivity
Test Cases: E2E-Smoke: Submit small prediction job, expect 200 and result stored | Auth-Smoke: Login and call protected endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Result stored and accessible; 200 responses for auth

Objectives: Validate prediction_jobs lifecycle (queued -> running -> completed/failed) | Verify model loading and checkpoint retrieval | Test feature extraction and feature_store population
Test Cases: Job-Lifecycle: Queue jobs with varying params | Model-Load: Load model from S3/path for inference/training
Acceptance Criteria: Statuses transition correctly; model loads without crash

Objectives: Load / stress test worker with concurrent jobs | Validate retry logic and graceful failure handling | Test storage (S3) and DB throughput under load
Test Cases: Concurrency: Submit 50-200 jobs concurrently | Retry-Logic: Simulate transient failures and ensure retry
Acceptance Criteria: No data loss; retries succeed or fail with clear errors

Objectives: Pen-test key endpoints (auth, upload) | Verify PII is not logged and password_hash protected | Check data consistency between feature_store, prediction_results and saved_graphs
Test Cases: Auth-Bypass: Attempt unauthorized access | Data-Consistency: Cross-check job -> results -> saved_graphs entries
Acceptance Criteria: Blocked unauthorized access; data references consistent

Objectives: Validate front-end workflows (submit, view graph, download) | Run regression suite against core APIs | User acceptance: sample users exercise main flows
Test Cases: UI-Submit: User submits job via UI | Regression-Full: Run full automated regression
Acceptance Criteria: No critical regressions; primary flows work for sample users
